en: Colorized historic view of a railway station with steam locomotives, tracks, platforms, and station buildings. The left side shows a two‑story masonry station house and adjoining covered platform structure. People stand along the platforms. On the right, a steam train approaches, with additional railway buildings and a water tower in the background. German text labels identify the location and platform information.
